svg.title: MotionTennis architecture big picture
svg.desc: Illustrative role images. Design hardware: ESP32 and MPU-6050 controllers, webcam, Pi 3 B and Windows laptop. Requirement IDs: F-01 F-03 F-08 F-12 F-13 F-19 N-05 N-06.
svg.text: Buffered traces from all nodes; collector planned.
1 Motion / pose input -> 2 Pi match calculation
3 State + views on PC -> 4 Feedback / display
Device pictures are illustrative; debug export never blocks gameplay.
